# Divshaan Singh Brar

> Freelance graphic designer and aspiring art director based in Brampton, Ontario, Canada (Greater Toronto Area). Available for freelance and contract work — brand identity and logos, advertising campaigns, social media design, print and editorial design, website design and 3D visualisation — for clients in Brampton, Mississauga, Toronto and remotely. Works in English, Punjabi and Hindi.

- Website: https://divshaan.design/

- Phone and text: +1 (437) 297-5009
- Contact form: https://divshaan.design/contact.html (replies within 48 hours)
- Based in: Brampton, Ontario, Canada — works in person across Brampton, Mississauga and Toronto, and remotely
- Availability: open to freelance and contract projects
- Pricing: quoted per project, based on scope, timeline and budget
- Education: George Brown Polytechnic, School of Design — advanced diploma in graphic design (2024–2026)
- Languages: English (professional), Punjabi and Hindi (native)
- Tools: Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, After Effects, Figma, Blender, HTML, CSS, JavaScript
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/divshaan-singh-brar-038b97251

## Services

- Art direction: campaign concepts, key visuals and brand narrative, from insight to execution.
- Advertising campaign design: integrated campaigns across out-of-home, print, digital, social, radio and direct mail.
- Brand identity and logo design: logos, rebrands, icon systems and brand guidelines.
- Social media design: posts, carousels and campaign content for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn.
- Editorial and print design: magazines, booklets, brochures, banners and posters, prepared for press.
- Website and UI design: website redesigns, UI design and live client builds, from Figma to HTML and CSS.
- 3D visualisation and motion: architectural visualisation, 3D films and motion pieces, art-directed and built with AI in Blender.

## Good fit for

- Small businesses, start-ups and professional practices in the GTA that need a logo, brand system, website or social content.
- Brands that want a campaign idea carried across out-of-home, print and social, not just single graphics.
- Organisations that need print collateral (brochures, banners, posters) prepared correctly for press.
- Businesses that want to brief and review work in Punjabi or Hindi as well as English.

## Experience

- Swiftronics — Graphic & Web Designer (May 2026–present): Shopify store, social media, internal tools for the team.
- Schulich ExecEd, York University — Freelance Graphic Designer (Apr 2025–Jan 2026): brochures, banners and social assets; co-branded materials for the Ontario Association of Chiefs of Police and DeGroote School of Business.
- George Brown Polytechnic — Student Makers Lab Technician (Sep 2024–Jan 2026): laser cutting, 3D printing and fabrication; guided 100+ students.
- US Webtech Solution, Sri Ganganagar — Social Media Marketing Intern (Apr–Dec 2023): social content and ad campaigns for Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn.

## Case studies

### Advertising

- [Depop — Taking the online thrift store offline](https://divshaan.design/work/depop.html): Integrated campaign bringing the online thrift store into real-life activations for Gen Z. Concept & art direction, student brief, 2024.
- [Duolingo — Let Duo Play the Cupid](https://divshaan.design/work/duolingo.html): Valentine's Day integrated campaign reframing language learning as connection. Concept & art direction, student brief, 2024.
- [Sapporo — The Sabbatical](https://divshaan.design/work/sapporo-sabbatical.html): Integrated campaign positioning Sapporo as the premium alternative to wine for high-end dining. Concept & art direction, thesis campaign, 2025.
- [Canadian Red Cross — Panic is Optional](https://divshaan.design/work/red-cross-panic.html): Integrated campaign for Red Cross First Aid Training. Concept & art direction, thesis campaign, 2025.
- [OWNED — Steam](https://divshaan.design/work/owned-steam.html): Integrated campaign turning Steam's permanent ownership model into a stance against subscription fatigue. Concept & art direction, thesis campaign, 2025.
- [Philips Smart Sleep — Wake Like a Human](https://divshaan.design/work/philips-smart-sleep.html): Out-of-home campaign for the Philips Sunrise Alarm Clock. Concept & art direction, 2025.
- [Xbox — Beyond Box](https://divshaan.design/work/xbox-beyond-box.html): Concept campaign about playing anywhere without limits. Concept & art direction, 2024.

### Editorial

- [Gamescom — Editorial & event branding](https://divshaan.design/work/gamescom-editorial.html): Promotional editorial and identity system for the gaming event. 2024.
- [Tanya Talaga — Rewriting Canadian History](https://divshaan.design/work/tanya-talaga.html): Editorial layout built around the author's work and story. 2024.

### Web & UI

- [Khushman Dhillon Law — Website](https://divshaan.design/work/khushman-law.html): Website designed and built for a Brampton barrister & solicitor. Client work, 2025.
- [Gamescom 2024 — Website redesign](https://divshaan.design/work/gamescom-ui.html): Conceptual high-energy redesign built to drive ticket sales. 2024.
- [Berkshire Hathaway — Website redesign](https://divshaan.design/work/berkshire-hathaway.html): Conceptual modernisation of a famously plain homepage. UI design & build, 2025.
- [Portfolio website](https://divshaan.design/work/portfolio-site.html): A personal portfolio site showcasing work across design disciplines. Design & build, 2025.

### 3D & Motion

- [Modern House — Walkthrough film](https://divshaan.design/work/modern-house.html): A three-storey house taken from a written brief to a 12-sheet drawing set, Blender model and two-minute ray-traced film. Art-directed by Divshaan, built with AI, 2026.
- [Echo City](https://divshaan.design/work/echo-city.html): A 20-second 3D art film where the letters of a word become a city. Directed by Divshaan, built with AI in Blender, 2026.
